original.target_description: Original manuscript reports object main effect on movement onset pooled over grasp and ward, not a separately printed food-versus-ball grasp contrast.

replication.target_description: Grasp movement onset: high-calorie food versus ball objects; summarized among all pairwise stimulus contrasts.

n.exclusions: One additional session cancelled; incorrect/early trials excluded and RT outliers removed before participant aggregation.
n.location: p. 1 abstract; analytic within-subject df corroborated on p. 5 (F(3,78)); cancelled additional session on p. 6

es.quote: For grasp movements, no stimulus differences were evident, Ws > 152, ps >.999.

p.quote: For grasp movements, no stimulus differences were evident, Ws > 152, ps >.999.

notes: Replication prints only a bound across grasp pairwise tests; no exact statistic for the food-versus-ball contrast. Original pooled object main effect cannot be substituted for this simple effect. Original title verified in author manuscript embedded in Lohmann dissertation; saved cache contains manuscript only. Replication title verified in publisher PDF web parse; local cache contains partial primary pages, not full paper.
